# Sports Content Playbook

> The content platform for sports social media teams: thousands of real posts from clubs, leagues and brands, why they worked and a weekly content plan.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/): What Sports Content Playbook is and how it works
- [Content Library](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/content-library.html): Real posts from sports clubs, leagues and brands, filtered by sport, platform, format and performance
- [Pricing](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/pricing.html): Plans and prices
- [SCP Knowledge Base](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/): Guides and answers on how to use Sports Content Playbook
- [Blog](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/blog.html): Sports social media trends, content ideas and news
- [Social News](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/news.html): Daily updates from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X and AI explained for sports teams
- [Jobs](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/jobs.html): Job offers in sports digital marketing: social media, content, design, video and partnerships
- [Book a demo](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/book-a-call.html): A 30-minute call with the team
- [Contact](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/contact.html): How to reach us

## SCP Knowledge Base

- [What is Sports Content Playbook and how does it work?](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/what-is-sports-content-playbook.html): Sports Content Playbook (SCP) is the content platform for sports social media teams: a library of 500,000+ real posts from 770+ clubs and 110+ competitions, an AI analysis that explains why each post worked, and a weekly Content Plan to schedule your own versions.
- [How to get started with Sports Content Playbook](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-get-started-with-sports-content-playbook.html): To get started with Sports Content Playbook, sign up at signup.html with your email or Google, start the 7-day free trial, follow the 5-step guided tour in the Content Library and fill in your favourites in Profile so the library shows posts relevant to your club first.
- [What are the main features of Sports Content Playbook?](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/main-features-of-sports-content-playbook.html): Sports Content Playbook has three main tools: the Content Library (500,000+ real sports posts with smart filters, every plan), AI analysis (why a post worked and how to adapt it, every plan) and the Content Plan (a week and month calendar, Plus and Pro). Enterprise clubs also get My Club, a private library of their own accounts.
- [How to find your first content idea in under 5 minutes](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/find-your-first-content-idea-in-5-minutes.html): In under 5 minutes you can go from login to a saved, adapted idea in Sports Content Playbook: search or filter the Content Library for your competition, open a post that performed well, save it to a board, unlock its AI analysis and copy the adaptation, hook template and caption draft for your club.
- [How to use the Content Library](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-use-the-content-library.html): The Content Library in Sports Content Playbook lets you browse 500,000+ real posts from clubs, leagues and brands: filter them in the left column, open a post to watch it and read its caption and tags, save it to a private board, run an AI analysis or share a public link to that single post.
- [How to search and filter content ideas](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-search-and-filter-content-ideas.html): In the Sports Content Playbook library you can type words or a whole sentence in the search box, which turns them into filters for free, then refine with the smart filters in the left column (What works, Match Day, Brands & sponsors, Where & how, Inspiration from), a period and a sort. Save any combination as a saved search or share it as a link.
- [What are Top Picks, Replicable Ideas and Overperforming?](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/top-picks-replicable-ideas-and-overperforming.html): Top Picks, Replicable ideas and Overperforming are three special selections in the Sports Content Playbook Content Library: Top Picks are the best posts chosen by the SCP team, Replicable ideas are formats you can recreate with your own assets, and Overperforming are posts that got at least 2x the usual results of their own account.
- [How to analyze a content idea](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-analyze-a-content-idea.html): To analyze a content idea in Sports Content Playbook, open the post in the Content Library and click Unlock AI Analysis: the AI breaks down its hook, format and angle, tells you how it performed against its own account and gives you hook ideas, a shot list and a caption draft. Each analysis uses 1 of your monthly AI analyses; reopening it later is free.
- [How to adapt a content idea to your club or organization](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-adapt-a-content-idea-to-your-club.html): To adapt a content idea in Sports Content Playbook, run the AI analysis on the post and use its How to adapt it to your club section and its Ready to use block (3 hook ideas, a shot list and a caption draft with placeholders), then drag the post to your Content Plan, where the AI's adaptation goes into the notes.
- [How to find trending content and creative inspiration](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-find-trending-sports-content.html): Sports Content Playbook has no single "trending" tab: to see what is working right now, filter the Content Library by a recent period (This week or This month), sort by Most viewed and add Overperforming, then narrow by platform and format. For platform news and sports social media trends, read Social News and the blog.
- [How does AI work in Sports Content Playbook?](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-does-ai-work-in-sports-content-playbook.html): Sports Content Playbook uses AI in two places: smart filters, AI labels that SCP applies to the posts in the library so you can filter by moment, angle or sponsor, and the AI analysis, which you unlock on a single post to get its hook, why it worked, how it performed and a ready-to-use version for your club. SCP has no AI chat or free-text generator.
- [How to generate content ideas using AI](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-generate-content-ideas-with-ai.html): Sports Content Playbook doesn't generate ideas from a blank prompt. Instead, its AI helps you find ideas that already worked (sentence search and smart filters, Overperforming, More like this) and then turns the one you choose into your own version: the AI analysis' Ready to use block gives you 3 hook ideas, a shot list and a caption draft for your club.
- [How to create captions, hooks and scripts with AI](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-create-captions-hooks-and-scripts-with-ai.html): Sports Content Playbook doesn't have a free-text caption or script generator. Every AI analysis ends with ready-to-use material instead — a reusable Hook template, 3 Hook ideas, a Shot list and a Caption draft with [placeholders] — that you turn into your own hook, short script and caption in a few minutes.
- [How to get better results from AI-generated suggestions](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-get-better-results-from-ai-suggestions.html): In Sports Content Playbook the AI suggestions are only as useful as the post you analyse. Pick a post that matches your sport, format and resources, check "How it performed" and "How to adapt it to your club", then rewrite the Hook ideas, Shot list and Caption draft with your club's real facts and voice.
- [How to set up your club in My Club](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-set-up-your-club-in-my-club.html): My Club isn't self-serve: the Sports Content Playbook team sets it up with you. You send the club's official accounts, players, sponsors, sections and the emails of your team; SCP links the accounts, creates the sections, adds the members and uploads your club's posts every day into a private space.
- [How to manage players, teams and club sections](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-manage-players-teams-and-club-sections.html): In My Club, players, teams and sections are managed by the Sports Content Playbook team on request: you send the changes (new signings, departures, a new team or section) and SCP updates them. You then use the Players tab and the Section and Team filters to see exactly the posts you need.
- [How to manage sponsors in My Club](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-manage-sponsors-in-my-club.html): Sponsors in My Club are added by the Sports Content Playbook team when you send their accounts. Once linked, the Sponsors tab shows every post from a brand or only the posts linked to your club, and the Brands & sponsors filters in the library show how other clubs activate their partners.
- [How to use the Content Planner](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-use-the-content-planner.html): The Content Plan (Content Planner) is the calendar of Sports Content Playbook, included in Plus and Pro. You drag posts from the Content Library onto a day, write the caption and notes, set the type and status (Idea, Planned, In production, Published) and export the week or month as PDF, Excel or a calendar file.
- [How to build a monthly content plan for your club](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-build-a-monthly-content-plan-for-your-club.html): To build a monthly content plan in Sports Content Playbook, open the Content Plan in Month view, mark your fixtures and the key dates of the month, set a Weekly base of recurring posts, fill the gaps with posts from the Content Library and download the month as PDF, Excel or a calendar file. The Content Plan is included in Plus and Pro.
- [How to organize your content workflow and team](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-organize-your-content-workflow-and-team.html): In Sports Content Playbook each person has their own account and a private Content Plan, so there is no shared team calendar. A team organises its workflow with statuses (Idea, Planned, In production, Published), a weekly base, exports of the week to Excel, PDF or .ics, shared search and post links, and AI analyses that teammates on the same plan can read for free.
- [What is the difference between Starter, Plus and Pro?](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/starter-plus-and-pro-plans-compared.html): Starter (€9/month) gives you the Content Library, search, smart filters, Match Day, Saved boards and 5 AI analyses a month. Plus (€19/month) adds the Content Creators filter, the Content Plan and 10 AI analyses. Pro (€49/month) adds the Brands & sponsors filters and 30 AI analyses. Prices are per user, VAT included, and Enterprise (My Club) is a custom plan from €99/month.
- [How does the 7-day free trial work?](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-does-the-7-day-free-trial-work.html): Every Sports Content Playbook plan starts with a 7-day free trial of the plan you choose. You add a card but pay €0 today, you get 5 AI analyses, and if you cancel before the trial ends nothing is charged. There is one trial per person or organisation, and you receive a reminder email before it ends.
- [How to manage your subscription and billing](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-manage-your-subscription-and-billing.html): You manage your Sports Content Playbook subscription in Profile → Billing & membership. There you can change plan, switch to yearly, update your card and download invoices, add up to 5 users, buy more AI analyses and cancel your membership. Upgrades apply at once (prorated); downgrades and cancellations apply at the end of the period you've paid for.
- [How to build a successful sports content strategy with SCP](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-build-a-sports-content-strategy-with-scp.html): With Sports Content Playbook you build a sports social media strategy in five steps: set your profile so the library shows clubs like yours, study what overperforms in your sport and competition, turn the formats that fit you into a weekly base of recurring posts, add key dates to your content calendar, and review the library every month to update the plan.
- [How to turn one content idea into multiple social media posts](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/help/how-to-turn-one-content-idea-into-multiple-posts.html): In Sports Content Playbook you turn one idea into several posts by hand, with three real features: search the same topic in other formats and platforms with the Format and Platform filters, use the AI analysis (Hook template, Hook ideas, Shot list, Caption draft) as the brief for each version, and plan each version as its own Reel, TikTok, Carousel or Story entry in the Content Plan. SCP does not convert or resize content automatically.
